procedural_matters: PER 379 was represented Rodrigo Benedetto PER Coach.
ESP 3696 was represented by Fernando Alegre, ESP Coach.
Race Committee was represented by Elena Papazoglou, IODA Course Representative.
Julian Viciano, Team Leader ESP, attended the hearing as an observer.
Nelson BRA, IJ, member jury, acted as an interpreter for ESP.
Hearing No. 10 was heard together with hearing No. 11 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident
facts: ESP and PER requested redress alleging an error by the Race Committee in scoring the match making their scores significantly worse for the races sailed on 01 July 25.
Team Racing SI 17.7 states “A boat may not request redress under RRS 61.4 (b)(1). This changes RRS 61.1 (a) and RRS 61.4 (b)(1)”.
conclusions: A boat may not request redress under RRS 61.4 (b)(1) as per SI 17.7. Therefore, the request for redress is invalid.
